Isolated compact composition, realistic natural textures, restrained earth colours and soft studio illumination, matching tuppi object plates. Where the passage names the patient performing an act (e.g. spitting), retain that allocation of roles. Background must be genuinely empty alpha transparency outside the people, animals and necessary objects: no landscape, backdrop, cloudy vignette or room. Keep the composition compact and readable at card size.
Edit this historical specimen plate ONLY to remove the blurred brown background outside the wooden board, knife and animal portions. Preserve the twelve real animal portions, their arrangement, anatomy, materials, board and knife exactly. Replace only the surrounding backdrop with genuine alpha transparency; do not replace or soften the depicted objects.
